project.name: Grass Touching Simulator
project.description: A cozy Phaser 3 browser game about touching grass, growing a field, unlocking skills, seeds, weather, and delightfully silly progression.

currentStatus.deployment: Latest saved game build was pushed to GitHub and deployed to Vercel before this handoff was created.
currentStatus.customDomain: grasstouchingsimulator.com and www.grasstouchingsimulator.com are the intended live domains.
currentStatus.userVerificationPreference: The user prefers to playtest in their own browser because the Codex browser tool has had issues in this thread.

recentCommits.message: Update playtester credits and mobile tile info
Polish skill tree and field feedback

recentWorkCompleted: Restored the pixel-art title screen art after a procedural replacement felt wrong.
Removed the visible '[ PRESS START ]' prompt from the active title menu experience.
Added moving leaf and flower selector sprites that follow the hovered or selected title menu option.
Fixed the bad translucent green title-screen bars caused by earlier overlay/hitbox attempts.
Added the custom domain context: grasstouchingsimulator.com.
Reworked the skill screen layout so it reads more like a tree instead of a tangled grid.
Muted secondary prerequisite lines on the skill tree to reduce visual clutter.
Added different grass-click sounds for different grass types.
Varied screen shake based on the kind of grass touched.
Allowed the grass field to grow much larger through progression.
Added mouse-wheel zoom and empty-space drag panning for the field.
Visualized Weather Jar effects with tinting, badge-style feedback, and particles.
Disabled the recurring mobile tile info popup after touch feedback showed it was annoying.
Updated credits with playtesters tussukarva🇫🇮🇸🇪 and 🔪⋆🎀  𝒦𝒾𝓉𝓉𝓎 𝒩💔𝒾𝓇 🎀⋆🔪.

gameDesignDirection.visualPreference: Keep the richer pixel-art look, especially on the title screen. Avoid flat/procedural replacement art unless explicitly requested.
gameDesignDirection.titleScreenPreference: The old title art is loved. Preserve it, but keep menu selection functional and clean.
gameDesignDirection.playtestLoop: User likes shipping small changes, playtesting quickly, then pushing/deploying once it feels right.

knownIssuesAndRisks: The restored title screen uses edited image assets and selector sprites. It is functional, but the title art cleanup may still deserve a proper art pass if artifacts appear.
The skill tree is improved but dense on phone screens, especially when everything is unlocked.
Progression balance at very high grass-touch counts is still prototype-level.
Large fields plus zoom/pan should continue to be phone-tested for performance and ergonomics.
Some shop or panel scroll areas may benefit from clearer mobile affordances.
Vite may warn about bundle size as the project grows; not urgent unless load time becomes a real issue.
recommendedNextSteps: Have the user verify the restored pixel-art title screen on localhost and live domain.
If title artifacts remain, do a careful image cleanup pass while preserving the original pixel-art style.
Improve phone usability for the skill tree, possibly with zoom, sections, or a cleaner mobile layout.
Continue balancing late-game costs and rewards beyond 30000 touches.
Add more seed/field/weather content now that zoom and larger fields are in place.
Consider a small visible changelog or debug build marker during rapid Vercel deploy testing.
